messages:
anya_cs: Orbitera (legaltech) asked to onboard a 13B translation model + embeddings for retrieval. They require PHI redaction, enterprise HSM for key management, and ability to run private deployment. Timeline: pilot in 3 weeks. Can CS/ENG confirm feasibility and what we need from them? @tom_eng @mike_research

 tom_eng: can you share sample docs and SLA targets? latency p50/p95 and tokens per request? Also is streaming required? :thinking:

 mike_research: need eval set (ideally 200-300 examples) covering contracts, court filings, email threads. Also include adversarial examples where PHI appears in metadata. Suggest model variant: `redwood-13b-legal-v1` quantized to int8 or nf4. What's their max seq len? :eyes:

 elaine_platform: deployment mode matters. if Private/VPC + HSM we'll need infra lead time (2-3 business weeks). Config example:
 ```
 model: redwood-13b-legal-v1
 quant: int8
 deploy: private
 kms: customer-hsm
 kv_cache: enabled
 embeddings_dim: 1536
 ```
 Also, embeddings pipeline: we'll expose an embeddings endpoint; what vector DB are they planning to use?

 derek_ops: FYI Orbitera is at 48% of committed usage this quarter — renewal risk if onboarding stalls. If we can move pilot to dedicated capacity with a signed 6-12 month commit we can prioritize SLA and onboarding support. Recommend offering a 3-week enablement + trial credits. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

 anya_cs: shared sample docs link with Orbitera. They prefer private with HSM and can provide KMS thumbprints. Pilot users = legal review team (5 users). Call scheduled Thurs 10am PT. Ticket: #CS-7890. @deploy-bot can you open an infra intake?

 deploy-bot: Infra intake created: INF-10234. Assigned: elaine_platform, tom_eng. ETA: 14 business days for private with HSM. :white_check_mark:

 aya_research: acceptance criteria suggestion: PHI redaction F1 >= 0.95 on our holdout; translation fidelity BLEU > 0.7 and retrieval MRR@10 > 0.6. We'll run noise/adversary tests. I'll coordinate eval harness – need anonymized ground truth from Orbitera.

 tom_eng: noted. I'll draft a checklist for the customer: sample docs (anonymized), workload profile (qps, avg tokens), preferred vector DB, KMS type, and compliance contacts. Will post the checklist in the thread later.

 anya_cs: thanks team — I'll collect docs from Orbitera and update ticket. flagging this as high priority for renewal. :pray:
